chunks: take upon yourselves your own training and turn away from the dictates of your natural inclinations.
ai.seo_question: How does one discipline the soul according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi presents this maxim as a call for active self-governance, where the individual transitions from being ruled by the 'tyranny' of base instincts to becoming their own just ruler. This concept of *adl* (justice) applied to the self reflects the Shia emphasis on internal moral equilibrium as a prerequisite for external spiritual and social justice.
